content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications can be submitted by email or sent to the official address: Email ID: [email protected] (by 06:00 PM on 05-11-2026) Postal Address: Directorate of Social Welfare & Social Education, Government of Tripura, Ujan Abhoynagar, Agartala, Tripura - 799005 Envelope Superscription: APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF STATE COMMISSIONER FOR PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES, TRIPURA

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: Essential: Graduate from a recognized University. Desirable: Recognized Degree or Diploma in Social Work, Law, Management, Human Rights, Rehabilitation or Education of Persons with Disabilities. Experience: At least 20 years of experience in a Group 'A' level or equivalent post in the Central Government or State Government; or in Public Sector Undertakings, Semi-Government or Autonomous Bodies dealing with disability-related matters or social sector; or as a senior-level functionary in a registered State, National, or International level voluntary organization working in the field of disability or social development. Special Knowledge: Must possess special knowledge or practical experience in respect of matters relating to rehabilitation of persons with disabilities. Age Limit: Must not have attained the age of 56 years as on 1st January of the year in which the last date for receipt of applications occurs. The term is for 3 years or until attaining the age of 65 years, whichever is earlier, for a maximum of two terms. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The appointment is made by the State Government on the recommendation of a Search-cum-Selection Committee. The committee recommends a panel of 3 suitable candidates to the State Government. Candidates must satisfy all eligibility conditions prescribed under Rule 21 of the Tripura Rights of Persons with Disabilities Rules, 2018.

faq.question: Q1. What is the salary admissible for the State Commissioner post?
faq.answer: The salary and allowances are as admissible to a Secretary to the State Government. For a retired Government Servant or retired employee of a funded institution/autonomous body in receipt of pension, the salary is reduced by the amount of pension and commuted portion of pension.

faq.question: Q2. Can retired government employees apply for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, retired Government Servants or retired employees of any institution or autonomous body funded by the Central or State Government can apply, subject to pension adjustment rules and the upper age limit of 65 years.

faq.question: Q3. How is the selection of candidates carried out?
faq.answer: The appointment is made by the State Government based on the recommendation of a Search-cum-Selection Committee, which recommends a panel of 3 suitable candidates from applicants and other eligible persons in Central or State employment.

faq.question: Q4. What are the desirable qualifications specified in the notification?
faq.answer: Desirable qualifications include a recognized Degree or Diploma in Social Work, Law, Management, Human Rights, Rehabilitation, or Education of Persons with Disabilities.
